svg.font-family: Inter,'Noto Sans SC','Source Han Sans SC','Microsoft YaHei','PingFang SC','Hiragino Sans GB',Segoe UI,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif
svg.text: Build and watch; fix where it jams
Tools left, settings right, queues and stranded along the bottom.
Pick blocks and kit, raise the station floor by floor.
Set entrances, lines and demand in the info panel.
Run it, read queues and stranded, go back and rebuild.
